The plinth front edge lands at 0.95 (canon range 0.90-0.93): the stage base is deep. Accent vermilion #fa5838 on the footlights; one footlight glass is tinted, the rest carry thin filaments. Viewer: circle inscribed in the viewer box. Ground = --bench-c-parchment. Portrait mobile crop (canon amendment 2026-10-20): canon/mobile.py, plate x 400-1200 full height scaled 0.9 to 720x900, centred on the machine axis; viewer 180 px wide. Wide machines lose their outer edges in this crop by design.
